findings.highlight: whoever possesses the same amount of Noble Phantasms could potentially go up against him.
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ数の宝具さえ持っていれば力は拮抗する
findings.governingReading: Rin says matching Gilgamesh's number of Noble Phantasms would balance their power.
findings.explanation: Rin's claim that equal numbers would balance their power becomes a possibility of challenging him. The next page still describes Emiya fighting on equal ground.

findings.highlight: He can tell that as soon as I Project one of Archer's swords.
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーの剣を一本投影するだけでボロが出るんだぞ
findings.governingReading: ボロが出る says even one projected Archer sword exposes Shirou's inadequacy or strain.
findings.explanation: Shirou's Projection showing its limitations becomes Gilgamesh noticing it.

findings.highlight: I don't know how to store my magical energy into gems like you.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂みたいに宝石に魔力を溜めている訳でもないし
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he has no jewels already charged with mana as Rin does.
findings.explanation: Lacking stored gems becomes lacking knowledge of storing mana in gems.

findings.highlight: I don't think she'll agree to that seeing that I don't have any training in magecraft to be able to utilize those gems.
findings.evidenceJa: 元から魔術の素養がない俺がそれをなんとかできるとは、やっぱり思えない
findings.governingReading: He cannot imagine someone without magical aptitude like him handling them.
findings.explanation: Shirou's doubt that he can use the gems becomes doubt that Rin will agree.

findings.highlight: "What? Th-there's no way I can tell you about something like that!
findings.evidenceJa: そんなこと士郎に言えるワケないじゃない！
findings.governingReading: The exclamation completes one dialogue string.
findings.explanation: Rin's spoken line lacks its closing quotation mark.

findings.highlight: Right in my face.
findings.evidenceJa: と。
findings.governingReading: The isolated と introduces narration that Rin summarily rejects his proposal.
findings.explanation: A connective beat becomes the unsupported fragment 'Right in my face.'

findings.highlight: when we fully exert all of our Magic Circuits.
findings.evidenceJa: 私の魔力と士郎の全魔術回路を使って初めて
findings.governingReading: The Reality Marble requires Rin's magical energy and Shirou's complete circuit set.
findings.explanation: Rin's mana plus all Shirou's circuits becomes all of both people's circuits.

findings.highlight: My mind would be more at ease if this was standardized like the ritual we perform to form contracts with our familiars.
findings.evidenceJa: 使い魔の契約ほど形式化していれば安全性は確保できる
findings.governingReading: A familiar contract is formalized enough to ensure safety.
findings.explanation: Ritual safety becomes Rin's peace of mind.

findings.highlight: me giving you my magical cirucit
findings.evidenceJa: 私の魔術回路を貴方に上げる
findings.governingReading: She contrasts the two rejected circuit-transfer directions.
findings.explanation: Magic Circuit is misspelled in Rin's conclusion.

findings.highlight: the crest is their muscle.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術刻印は肉と言えるものだ
findings.governingReading: Circuits are blood and bone; the Magic Crest is flesh.
findings.explanation: The crest's analogy to flesh is narrowed to muscle.

findings.highlight: magecraft that this generation's family head created.
findings.evidenceJa: 歴代の当主が“形”にした魔術を行使できる
findings.governingReading: Rin uses magecraft that heads throughout the lineage gave form in the inherited crest.
findings.explanation: Magecraft shaped by successive heads becomes work of this generation's head.

findings.highlight: I will overcome my biggest failure with everything I've got.
findings.evidenceJa: ここ一番の失敗も、今回ばかりはねじ伏せてやるわ
findings.governingReading: ここ一番の失敗 is failure when it matters most, which she will suppress this time.
findings.explanation: Rin's tendency to fail at decisive moments becomes her biggest past failure.

findings.highlight: it's hard to know what to like about you.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂のいいところって、分かりづらいよな
findings.governingReading: Shirou says her good qualities are hard to recognize because she hides them.
findings.explanation: Rin's hard-to-see virtues become difficulty knowing what there is to like.

findings.highlight: I only thought of you as a goodie two-shoes at school
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の事を優等生だって思ってたし
findings.governingReading: 優等生 names Rin's polished honor-student persona.
findings.explanation: Model student becomes the pejorative goodie two-shoes.

findings.highlight: I'm just a woman who's cold as the iceberg.
findings.evidenceJa: どうせ猫かぶりで冷酷な女ですよ
findings.governingReading: 猫かぶり calls her school persona an act before she calls herself cold.
findings.explanation: Rin's self-accusation of wearing a false persona disappears.

findings.highlight: has the heart of steel who's willing to discard her weakness at a moment's notice.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の弱さをきっぱりと切り捨てる強い心
findings.governingReading: She has a strong heart that decisively cuts away her own weakness.
findings.explanation: Rin's strong heart becomes a heart of steel 'who' acts at a moment's notice.

findings.highlight: my becoming franctic will ruin this whole thing.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が心乱れれば台無しになる
findings.governingReading: Losing composure would ruin the rite.
findings.explanation: Frantic is misspelled.

findings.highlight: As I began receiving magical energy, the pattern on the upper area of my exposed arm faintly started to shine.
findings.evidenceJa: 腕は剥き出しで、二の腕の模様が魔力を得てうっすらと浮かび上がっていた
findings.governingReading: Rin extends her bare left arm; its upper-arm pattern appears as it gains energy.
findings.explanation: Rin's glowing crest-bearing arm becomes Shirou's arm already receiving mana.

findings.highlight: If you don't focus you will be pulled about by our shared senses
findings.evidenceJa: 集中しないと共有感覚に弾かれる
findings.governingReading: Without focus the synchronized sensation may reject or throw him out.
findings.explanation: Being repelled by shared sensation becomes being pulled about by it.

findings.highlight: this world where acceleration and termination exist at the same time.
findings.evidenceJa: 高速と停止の混ざり合った世界
findings.governingReading: The world combines high speed with a stopped state.
findings.explanation: Stillness becomes termination in the inner-world paradox.

findings.highlight: I already severed things that I've deemed unnecessary to this place
findings.evidenceJa: 余分なもの、此処では無くてもいいものを削られてきた
findings.governingReading: He has been pared down of things unnecessary there and discovers his limbs gone.
findings.explanation: The process stripping unnecessary parts becomes Shirou deliberately severing them.

findings.highlight: my current finite state of serenity.
findings.evidenceJa: カタチそのものが静かで、完結している
findings.governingReading: The form itself, rather than sound, is quiet and complete.
findings.explanation: A quiet, complete form becomes a finite emotional state of serenity.

findings.highlight: This place welcomes visitors.
findings.evidenceJa: ここは訪れた者を意図とするもの
findings.governingReading: The completed world has no will; it treats the visitor's intention as operative input.
findings.explanation: A world oriented around a visitor's intention becomes a welcoming place.

findings.highlight: The memory of a person who watched their loved one leave knowing she would never hold his hands again.
findings.evidenceJa: もう手を繋ぐ事はないと見送った余人の記憶
findings.governingReading: Someone remembers seeing another person off knowing they will never hold hands again.
findings.explanation: An unspecified farewell acquires romance and fixed genders.

findings.highlight: It is like a malicious bulbul.
findings.evidenceJa: 悪質なトラツグミに似ている
findings.governingReading: トラツグミ names the bird in the invasive-process simile.
findings.explanation: A thrush comparison becomes a bulbul.

findings.highlight: binded
findings.evidenceJa: 緊縛され
findings.governingReading: The self is locked, bound, divided, dismantled, compressed, and toyed with.
findings.explanation: Bound is misspelled as binded.

findings.highlight: She doesn't feel any disgust.
findings.evidenceJa: 気持ちの悪さなどない
findings.governingReading: After recognizing Rin's pain and admiring her, Shirou says his own experience is no longer disgusting.
findings.explanation: Shirou overcoming disgust becomes Rin not feeling disgust.

findings.highlight: It was meaningless, yet he kept trying until sunset.
findings.evidenceJa: 意味もなく、日が沈むまで
findings.governingReading: 意味もなく modifies her sustained watching; his repeated runs were already stated.
findings.explanation: Rin watching until sunset becomes the jumper trying until sunset.

findings.highlight: I thought I was seeing more fingers.
findings.evidenceJa: 指が増えたような誤認
findings.governingReading: The altered body creates a mistaken sensation as though fingers increased.
findings.explanation: A proprioceptive sense of extra fingers becomes visually seeing fingers.

findings.highlight: I can sense the tension between us... She's clearly sulking about something.
findings.evidenceJa: 今にもカンシャクを起こしそうなぐらい、拗ねている
findings.governingReading: She is so sulky she appears on the verge of a tantrum.
findings.explanation: Rin looking ready to explode becomes general tension between them.

findings.highlight: it shouldn't have any effect on the human body.
findings.evidenceJa: 人体にもそう影響はない筈だし
findings.governingReading: Because the graft is only a mana path, Rin expects it should not affect the body very much.
findings.explanation: Little expected bodily effect becomes no effect.

findings.highlight: don't expect me to apologize.
findings.evidenceJa: ごめん、なんて言わせないわ
findings.governingReading: ごめん、なんて言わせない makes Shirou the prospective apologizer.
findings.explanation: Rin refusing to let Shirou apologize becomes refusing to apologize herself.

findings.highlight: you owe me a trillion
findings.evidenceJa: お金にしたらもう兆クラス
findings.governingReading: If converted to money, the favor would be trillion-class; it is lifelong.
findings.explanation: A trillion-class comparison becomes a literal trillion debt.

findings.highlight: an idiot who wouldn't give up on high jumping
findings.evidenceJa: バカみたいに棒高跳びしてるヤツ
findings.governingReading: Shirou says 棒高跳び here, despite the earlier memory saying 走り高跳び.
findings.explanation: Pole vault is silently normalized to high jump.

findings.highlight: She won't hear me out at all.
findings.evidenceJa: 最後まで聞けなかった
findings.governingReading: He does not get to hear or ask through to the end before ejection.
findings.explanation: Shirou being unable to finish becomes Rin refusing to hear him out.
